ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface is approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-grey) and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Primary contiguous high-intensity region with dark perimeter and sparse focal dark blobs. Right lobe: High-intensity background populated with ~25 distinct low-intensity elliptical and circular blobs concentrated in the distal quadrant. Central junction: Solid low-intensity contiguous region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a high-frequency serration pattern; distinct jagged peaks (5-10 pixel amplitude) are localized on the distal margins, with micro-serrations (1-2 pixels) along the remaining continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a symmetrical convex curve sweeping from the central axis to the distal tips, with a slight recurve at the apex of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of roughly circular dark-pixel clusters on the distal half of the right lobe; white high-intensity pixel clusters observed at the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct parallel, diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe; multiple intersecting faint linear marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Proninent parallel rake marks on the left ventral surface; irregular jaggedness on the right fluke tip suggesting minor structural loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a dense, localized leopard-like spotting pattern on the right lobe distal region.
